items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities, including Template Engine Injection (BlockStrap)
items.summary: Adobe released a security update addressing 11 vulnerabilities, with CVE-2026-103849 being a critical template engine injection (BlockStrap) allowing unauthenticated arbitrary code execution. This bulletin also fixes an incorrect authorization flaw in B2B (CVE-2026-92909) allowing unauthenticated code execution.

items.title: Template Engine Injection (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: Adobe released an emergency security update for a critical template engine injection vulnerability, publicly known as StyleSmuggler, that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code. Adobe is aware of this CVE being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities, including Stored Cross-Site Scripting and Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: This security bulletin addresses eight vulnerabilities, six of which are exploitable without authentication, including two critical stored cross-site scripting flaws (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201) and several incorrect authorization flaws. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: An unauthenticated incorrect authorization flaw allows remote attackers to bypass access controls and gain elevated privileges over sensitive store data and configuration without user interaction. This vulnerability was added to the CISA KEV catalog on September 24, 2026.

items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities, including Security Feature Bypass and Privilege Escalation
items.summary: Adobe released a security update resolving critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service. Adobe was not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues at the time of publication.

items.title: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type (PolyShell)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, known as PolyShell, allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store via the REST API, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution. CISA added this flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on October 27, 2026.

items.title: PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in the Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension, allowing remote code execution via a crafted cookie on any storefront page. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) to address this vulnerability.
